fixes.what: No mirror of the Hunnic occupation of 408-409 that huns.json records (/ledger/6 occupation_start 408, /ledger/7 occupation_end 409/3, conf 2/3).
fixes.why: Uldin page: 'In the summer of 408 ... they entered the Balkans and Thrace.' 'The Huns captured Castra Martis in Dacia Ripensis.' Uldin 'was forced to re-cross the Danube by March 23, 409.'
fixes.fix: Add occupation_start 408 (month 7 or none) and occupation_end 409/3, counterpart 'huns', region {'place': 'Castra Martis'} as a coordinate (Kula, Bulgaria, about 22.52 E 43.89 N, km 40) or the huns dossier's {'region': 'Moesia'} with text 'Castra Martis in Dacia Ripensis', source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uldin (add to sources), conf 3 for the end and 2 for the start; add a war entry 'Uldin's invasion of Thrace' 408-409.

fixes.what: The Visigothic occupation is drawn over Thessaly, Central Greece, Attica, the Peloponnese and Epirus for all of 395-401, although the event's own region text ('... the Peloponnese (395-397), then Epirus (397-401)') and /keyframe_review/2 ('Greece returns but Epirus ...') say Greece was free from 397: the map hatches Greece for four years too many.
fixes.why: Alaric I page: Stilicho 'pushed Alaric's forces north into Epirus'; in 397 Eutropius 'established Alaric as magister militum per Illyricum'.
fixes.fix: Add an occupation_end 397, counterpart 'visigoths', region union Thessaly + Central Greece + Attica + Peloponnese (source Alaric_I, conf 2), and narrow /ledger/5 (401 occupation_end) to {'region': 'Epirus'}; keep /ledger/2's text.

fixes.what: Dengizich's war on the Eastern Empire (467-469) is absent, though /ledger/13's note quotes 'In 469, Dengizich was defeated and killed in Thrace' and huns.json carries contest_start 467 / contest_end 469 with eastern-roman-empire over Moesia + Thrace.
fixes.why: Huns page (in sources) as quoted in /ledger/13; huns.json /ledger/19-20 (source Dengizich).
fixes.fix: Add a war 'Dengizich's war' 467-469, belligerents eastern-roman-empire and huns, zone Moesia + Thrace, and a contest_start 467 / contest_end 469 pair (counterpart 'huns'), or a war with empty zones and the reason if no ground changed hands.

fixes.what: Garmul's war against the Eastern Romans in Africa (570-578), listed in mauro-roman-kingdom.json's wars, has no entry; the dossier's Moorish wars end in 548.
fixes.why: history/polities/mauro-roman-kingdom.json wars: 'Garmul's war on the Eastern Romans' 570-578.
fixes.fix: Add the war (Praetorian prefecture of Africa page or the Mauro-Roman Kingdom page), with empty zones and the reason if no ground changed hands; not blocking on its own.
